title: Realization of additive Cech cycles by equal total augmentation classes
statement: Let X be any scheme [def-pc-scheme], U a finite open cover of X, I an injective resolution [def-sp-injective-resolutions] of the lifted additive structure sheaf [def-sc-etale-additive-structure-restriction], n a natural number, and z a degree-n cycle in the ordinary unit-module Cech complex [lem-pc-flat-cech-base-change]. With global sections, total complex and alpha and beta components as in [def-pbc-etale-additive-cech-normalization], there exist a global-section cycle s and total cycles t_alpha,t_beta whose inclusions equal alpha(s) and beta(z), and whose total homology classes agree. No affine-intersection, compactness, separatedness or edge-equivalence hypothesis is imposed.

source.place: Lemma 20.11.2, augmentation alpha quasi-isomorphism and coefficient augmentation beta; adapted to the small etale open-cover site.

proof.text: Use the coefficient closedness theorem to construct t_beta via the abstract cycles-to-kernel isomorphism. Use the alpha quasi-isomorphism to lift its homology class. Surjectivity of global homology projection supplies s. Set t_alpha=cyclesMap(alpha)(s). The cycles inclusion formula and homology projection naturality give all three equalities.

proof_origin.place: Lemma 20.11.2; explicit cycle lifting through homology projection.

lean.statement:
theorem etaleAdditiveCech_cycle_realization
    {X : Scheme.{u}} {ι : Type u} [Finite ι] (U : ι → X.Opens)
    (hcover : iSup U = ⊤)
    (I : InjectiveResolution X.etaleAdditiveSheaf) (n : ℕ)
    (z : (cechOver X.toSpecΓ U (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf)).cycles n) :
    ∃ (s : (additiveCechGlobal I).cycles n)
      (tα tβ : (additiveCechTotal U I).cycles n),
      (additiveCechTotal U I).iCycles n tα =
        additiveCechAlpha U I n ((additiveCechGlobal I).iCycles n s) ∧
      (additiveCechTotal U I).iCycles n tβ = additiveCechBeta U I n
        ((cechOver X.toSpecΓ U
          (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf)).iCycles n z) ∧
      (additiveCechTotal U I).homologyπ n tα =
        (additiveCechTotal U I).homologyπ n tβ
